description: Defines the AddressTrackerLinux class responsible for tracking network interface addresses and online links on Linux systems using rtnetlink. It includes methods for initialization, retrieving address maps, setting callbacks for address and link changes, and managing network connection state.

classes.name: AddressTrackerLinux
classes.description: Manages tracking of network interface addresses and online links on Linux, providing callbacks for changes and methods for retrieving current network state.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Constructor for non-tracking mode, takes a snapshot of current system configuration.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Constructor for tracking mode, sets callbacks for address, link, and tunnel changes, and ignored interfaces.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Starts watching system configuration for changes in tracking mode.

methods.name: InitWithFdForTesting
methods.description: Initializes with a provided file descriptor for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAddressMap
methods.description: Returns current address map; callable on any thread.

methods.name: GetOnlineLinks
methods.description: Returns set of online interface indices; callable on any thread.

methods.name: GetInitialDataAndStartRecordingDiffs
methods.description: Returns current address map and online links, and starts recording diffs; callable on any thread.

methods.name: SetDiffCallback
methods.description: Sets callback to be called on address/link changes in tracking mode.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns current network connection type; blocks until Init completes.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Returns interface name given its index.

methods.name: IsTunnelInterfaceName
methods.description: Checks if interface name refers to a tunnel.
